クラス Enemy

java.lang.Object
model.entity.Enemy
public class Enemy extends Object
Represents an enemy target in the combat simulation.

Tracks the enemy's level, per-element resistances, and the live elemental aura state used by ReactionResult and CombatSimulator to resolve elemental reactions.

Constructed with KQM-standard 10 % resistance across all elements for reproducible benchmark comparisons.

  • メソッドの詳細

    • setAura

      public void setAura(Element element, double units)
      Sets the elemental aura gauge for the given element to units. If units is zero or negative the aura is removed entirely.
      パラメータ:
      element - element whose aura gauge to set
      units - gauge units to assign (must be positive to register an aura)

    • setAura

      public void setAura(Element element, double units, double currentTime)
      Sets a runtime elemental aura with natural expiry derived from gauge units.

      Current combat logic uses common 1U/2U/4U durations in a simplified form: 6 + gauge * 5 seconds. This gives 1U=11s, 2U=16s, and 4U=26s, matching the broad relative behavior needed by rotation tests.

      パラメータ:
      element - element whose aura gauge to set
      units - gauge units to assign
      currentTime - current simulator time in seconds

    • reduceAura

      public void reduceAura(Element element, double decay)
      Reduces the gauge of the given element by decay units, ignoring natural decay.

      This no-argument form is a compatibility wrapper that subtracts from the stored units at the aura's last application time. Mechanic decisions that depend on simulation time should call reduceAura(model.type.Element, double, double) so the decayed current value is consumed instead.

      パラメータ:
      element - element whose gauge to reduce
      decay - amount to subtract from the current gauge

    • reduceAura

      public void reduceAura(Element element, double decay, double currentTime)
      Reduces the gauge of the given element by decay units, consuming the value remaining after continuous natural decay up to currentTime.

      If the remaining value after consumption drops to zero or below, the aura is removed. Otherwise natural decay continues from the new remaining value at the aura's original decay rate.

      パラメータ:
      element - element whose gauge to reduce
      decay - amount to subtract from the decayed current gauge
      currentTime - current simulator time in seconds

    • getAuraUnits

      public double getAuraUnits(Element element)
      Returns the stored gauge units for the given element without applying natural decay, or 0.0 if no aura of that element is applied.

      This no-argument form is a compatibility wrapper. Mechanic decisions that depend on simulation time should call getAuraUnits(model.type.Element, double) to read the decayed current value.

      パラメータ:
      element - element to query
      戻り値:
      stored aura gauge units at the last application time

    • getAuraUnits

      public double getAuraUnits(Element element, double currentTime)
      Returns the remaining gauge units for the given element at currentTime after continuous natural decay, or 0.0 if no aura of that element is applied.
      パラメータ:
      element - element to query
      currentTime - current simulator time in seconds
      戻り値:
      decayed remaining aura gauge units, never negative

    • updateAuras

      public void updateAuras(double currentTime)
      Removes runtime auras that have expired by the given simulator time, either because their expiry has passed or their decayed value has reached zero.
      パラメータ:
      currentTime - current simulator time in seconds

    • getPrimaryAura

      public Element getPrimaryAura()
      Returns the primary active aura element. If both Element.HYDRO and Element.ELECTRO are simultaneously present (Electro-Charged state), HYDRO is returned as the nominal primary. Returns null when no aura is active.
      戻り値:
      primary aura element, or null if the enemy has no aura

    • getPrimaryAura

      public Element getPrimaryAura(double currentTime)
      Returns the primary active aura element using decayed current units at the given simulator time. Auras that have naturally decayed to zero are ignored. As with getPrimaryAura(), a simultaneous Element.HYDRO/Element.ELECTRO (Electro-Charged) state returns HYDRO as the nominal primary.
      パラメータ:
      currentTime - current simulator time in seconds
      戻り値:
      primary aura element, or null if no aura remains

    • getActiveAuras

      public Set<Element> getActiveAuras()
      Returns the set of all elements currently applied as an aura on this enemy without applying natural decay.

      This no-argument form is a compatibility wrapper. Mechanic decisions that depend on simulation time should call getActiveAuras(double) so naturally decayed auras are excluded.

      戻り値:
      snapshot set of active aura elements

    • getActiveAuras

      public Set<Element> getActiveAuras(double currentTime)
      Returns the set of elements whose decayed gauge is still positive at the given simulator time.
      パラメータ:
      currentTime - current simulator time in seconds
      戻り値:
      snapshot set of active aura elements after natural decay

    • getAuraMap

      public Map<Element,Double> getAuraMap()
      Returns a snapshot copy of the full aura gauge map (element -> units) using stored units without applying natural decay.

      This no-argument form is a compatibility wrapper. Snapshot consumers that depend on simulation time should call getAuraMap(double) to read decayed current values.

      戻り値:
      copy of the aura gauge map

    • getAuraMap

      public Map<Element,Double> getAuraMap(double currentTime)
      Returns a snapshot copy of the aura gauge map (element -> units) using decayed current units at the given simulator time. Elements whose decayed value has reached zero are omitted.
      パラメータ:
      currentTime - current simulator time in seconds
      戻り値:
      copy of the aura gauge map after natural decay

    • captureAuraState

      public Map<Element,double[]> captureAuraState()
      Captures the full per-element aura state for simulator snapshot/rollback.

      Each entry holds {units, applicationTime, duration} so that continuous natural decay can be resumed exactly after a restore, rather than being flattened to a non-decaying value.

      戻り値:
      a copy of the aura state keyed by element

    • restoreAuraState

      public void restoreAuraState(Map<Element,double[]> state)
      Restores aura state previously captured by captureAuraState(), replacing any current auras. Future natural decay resumes from the restored values, preserving the original decay behavior across rollback.
      パラメータ:
      state - captured aura state keyed by element; null clears all auras

      public void setRes(StatType elementType, double value)
      Sets the resistance value for the given element type. Uses the StatType DMG_BONUS key as the resistance map key (e.g. StatType.PYRO_DMG_BONUS for Pyro resistance).

      elementType - the StatType DMG_BONUS key representing the element
      value - resistance value as a decimal (e.g. 0.10 for 10 %)
